blocks.html: Halloween is the season of dressing up in the fanciest and scariest costumes and being stuffed to the brim with sweet treats. To celebrate the spookiest yet most colorful event of October, Robinsons Malls has prepared great treats for everyone.

With magic shows, spooky booths, photo corners and games a plenty, kids and even adults are guaranteed a Spooktastic time! Don’t forget to have your kids wear their best costume as exciting freebies and prizes await the one with the scariest yet cutest costume at Robinsons Malls’ Costume Contest. They can even join the Costume Parade with their pals. And finally, Halloween will never be complete without the Kiddie Trick-or-Treat where your little ones can fill their pumpkin pails with chocolates and candies. Sweet!

Excited? Then celebrate Halloween at Robinsons Malls on these dates: October 27 at Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Tacloban, Robinsons North Tacloban, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Dumaguete and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu; October 28 at Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Metro East, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Place Angeles, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Roxas, Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Place Iligan, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Tagaytay, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons Place Jaro, Robinsons Place Ormoc, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Cebu Fuente and Robinsons Place General Trias; October 29 at Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao; October 30 at Robinsons Place Butuan; and on October 31 at Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Pavia, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Luisita and Robinsons Place Naga.
